name: Microgrid utility-return qualification
summary: Qualifies the utility restoration condition before enabling the assigned reconnect process.
description: Qualifies the utility restoration condition before enabling the assigned reconnect process. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Utility voltage and health” at the input and “Qualified utility-available state” at the output. Availability is distinct from synchronism.
